title: Grantha Data Schema (Complete Single File)
description: Defines a complete grantha contained within a single file. Also serves as the source of truth for common definitions. Versioned using semantic versioning.

kind.description: Explicit file-type discriminator. Must be 'grantha' for flat single-file editions.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema in semver format (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Major version changes indicate breaking schema changes.

edition_id.description: Unique identifier for this edition. For single-edition granthas, use the grantha_id by convention.

tags.description: Optional free-form classification tags. Complement the single-valued text_type with additional categories (e.g., ['prakarana', 'upanishads', 'vedas']).

sections.description: Optional curated navigation sections (e.g. Raghavachar §1–§16 for Vedārthasaṅgraha). Absent for texts without curated section data.

commentary.description: Exactly one commentary per edition. Absent if this is a mūla-only edition. Mutually exclusive with `commentaries`: emit `commentary` when exactly one commentary, `commentaries` when two or more. TODO (schema): eliminate this singular field and always emit the plural `commentaries` array (breaking → MAJOR). Retained for backward compatibility with the existing corpus.

commentaries.description: Two or more commentaries for one edition (e.g. a bhāṣya plus a subcommentary carrying parent_commentary_id). Mutually exclusive with the singular `commentary`. TODO (schema): make this the single canonical shape and drop `commentary` (breaking → MAJOR).

edition_kind.description: The edition's declared kind (per-block presentation model): derived at build time from commentary presence. Gates the commentary pane; does not drive per-block mula presentation. Present on flat single-file granthas and on edition-sub-envelopes.

section_label.description: Bilingual label for a section or subsection.

subsection.description: A curated subtopic within a section, spanning a contiguous range of passages.

start_ref.description: ref of the first passage in this subsection.

end_ref.description: ref of the last passage in this subsection.

section.description: A curated top-level section spanning a contiguous range of passages.

start_ref.description: ref of the first passage in this section.

end_ref.description: ref of the last passage in this section.

oneOf.description: Array of child structure levels (preferred format)
Single child structure level (legacy format - will be converted to array)

span.description: A mula<->bhashya word-link span: an id shared by a mula passage span and one-or-more bhashya (commentary_passage) spans, with half-open character offsets into the corresponding content.sanskrit.devanagari string.

reference.description: A structured cross-text citation emitted by the producer-side reference pipeline (grantha-data tools/lib/grantha_data/references.py). Half-open character offsets into the corresponding content.sanskrit.devanagari string. Three states: (1) undefined abbreviation -> grantha_id null, unresolved true (build error); (2) normal passage/section/range link -> grantha_id set, locator string, unresolved false; (3) whole-work citation -> grantha_id set, locator null, unresolved false.

display_text.description: Verbatim citation text as written in the source.

grantha_id.description: Resolved text id. Null ONLY when the abbreviation is undefined (build error).

edition_id.description: The concrete resolved edition (school-namespace design §4.3). Empty/absent for mula or school-neutral targets; set for school-resolved targets. The runtime links only when the exact (grantha, edition) is on disk; an edition_id for an edition not in the library renders not-in-library (never another school's default).

locator.description: Canonical dotted target. Null for a whole-work citation; for a range this is the first endpoint.

locator_end.description: Normalized high endpoint. Present only for ranges (when locator is the range's first endpoint).

group_id.description: Present only on enumeration members, grouping the expanded comma-list into one logical citation.

unresolved.description: True when a build REF-* error was emitted for this reference (undefined abbreviation).

quote.description: Precomputed source-side quote span (build-time citation matcher). Half-open offsets into content.sanskrit.devanagari of the CITING passage; present only when the matcher found a confident span. Lets the runtime highlight the quote exactly without matching.

status.description: Optional; absent means 'matched'. Reserved for a future below-floor signal.

kind.description: The markdown heading word (e.g. 'Para', 'Shloka') declaring the passage's presentation kind (per-block presentation model). Required on `main` passages; must be absent on prefatory/concluding.

speaker.description: The standalone mula speaker attribution of a verse (e.g. 'सञ्जय उवाच', 'श्रीभगवानुवाच'). Set from a <!-- speaker --> block; verse-level only.

spans.description: Mula<->bhashya word-link spans. Half-open character offsets into content.sanskrit.devanagari; identical id on a passage span and a commentary_passage span is the correspondence.

references.description: Structured cross-text citations in the main (mula) passage text (school-namespace design §4.3). Present only when the mula prose carries citations (e.g. vedarthasangraha).

verse_quotes.description: Runs of quoted verses within a main (mula) passage, marked by <!-- verse-quote --> blocks. Half-open offsets into content.sanskrit.devanagari; the presentation layer hang-indents each run and pāda-splits long metres. Present only when the passage quotes verses.

verses.description: The work's OWN verses (maṅgala/colophon/authored) within a passage, marked by <!-- verse --> blocks. Half-open offsets into content.sanskrit.devanagari; rendered like verse-quotes but semantically distinct (not embedded citations). Present only when the passage contains own verses.

parent_commentary_id.description: When this commentary is a subcommentary, the commentary_id of its parent commentary. Omitted for direct commentaries on the mula.

intro.description: The commentary's own opening prose for this part: whole-work mangalacarana on part 1, chapter summary on other parts. Set from an intro-only commentary block placed before the first verse or under a # Prefatory: anchor.
The verse lead-in (avatārikā) that introduces this verse's gloss. Set from an <!-- intro --> child of the verse's commentary block.

spans.description: Mula<->bhashya word-link spans. Half-open character offsets into content.sanskrit.devanagari; identical id on a passage span and a commentary_passage span is the correspondence.

references.description: Structured cross-text citations in this commentary passage. Half-open character offsets into content.sanskrit.devanagari.
